data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin designed to handle secondary presentation displays.
data.what_it_does: It provides methods to interact with connected displays, show and hide secondary presentation screens, listen to display connection changes, and transfer data between the main and secondary displays.
use_when: You need to display a separate presentation screen on an external monitor or secondary device display.
You need to pass data back and forth between the main display and a secondary presentation screen.
avoid_when: You only need standard single-screen navigation inside your app.
You are building for platforms that do not support secondary presentation displays (only Android is explicitly mentioned/tested).
strengths: Includes stream listeners for connection changes and data transfer between displays.
Supports fullscreen mode to hide system bars on secondary displays.
weaknesses: Limited platform documentation and testing details (explicitly tested on SUNMI T2s).
Requires manual entry-point setup with specific pragmas for the secondary display.
data.setup_notes: Requires defining a secondary entry point in main.dart annotated with @pragma('vm:entry-point').
